purpose: Full lettering-free panel reconstruction, with original artwork restored after generated extension work.
inputs: prepare_inputs.py extracts page 247 from the local PDF through the established ink/background pipeline. The raw originals, smoothed locks, fixed canvases, reference crops and selected generated results are retained here.
assembly: assemble.py builds panel 2 from the locked upper artwork, extended only to the left, where dad2_refine.py draws Dad's back and sleeve. Panel 3 starts from the cleaned scan crop with panel 1's Calvin and record player enlarged beside it; dad3.py inks Dad outside the crop from a ChatGPT drawing of the pose (dad3-chatgpt.webp), registered to the scan by his head and warped so its lines meet the scan's at the crop's edges.
generation: Built-in imagegen was used for earlier versions of the lower scenes (prompts kept here); none of its output remains in Dad's figure.
preservation: Panels 1, 3 and 4 preserve the full cleaned scan rectangle pixel for pixel. Panel 2 retains the earlier elbow repair. Its original-crop match is 99.206%.
review: build_review.py creates panels.html with full-resolution links and a source overlay, and output/full-panels.zip. The editor crop/layout assets are separate from these full-art exports.
scale: At full resolution the head widths of Calvin and Dad are respectively 602 and 493 pixels in panel 2, 693 and 562 pixels in panel 3. The enlargement of the original seated child and player in panel 3 is 1.56×.
visualReview: 1: Wide view. Dad walks toward the seated child, shoes and player are visible.
2: The thigh continues from the scanned silhouette to a rounded knee short of the player, the shin folds under it along the floor, and the near shoe lies behind him with its sole turned up.

3: The shirt hangs loose over the drawn lap, the near arm drops from its rolled cuff to a hand resting on the thigh with its fingers towards the knee, and the gesturing arm bends at an elbow below the crop. The foreshortened shoe trails under his seat. The planted feet and upturned face of Calvin come from panel 1.
4: Bed scene. Calvin, his hands and the hatching on the blanket remain legible against the black ground.
drawing: Panel 2: dad2_refine.py and ink.py draw Dad's back and sleeve in code, with tapered brush strokes rendered supersampled and thresholded to 1-bit ink; drawn_legs.transplant() moves pieces of Watterson's own ink. Panel 3: dad3.py takes Dad from the ChatGPT drawing, removing its floor marks, straightening a hook in the shirt's front edge, and cutting away what of its hand shows below the crop (Watterson's hand sits a little higher).
